# NicTUI v1.1.0

## Easier To Use

- Responsive layouts, clearer selection and action hints, and improved colour handling for true-colour, 256-colour, basic-colour, and monochrome terminals.
- Contextual `F1` help in every view and editor, without losing your draft.
- Clearer empty states and guidance for reading, importing, exporting, and writing radio data.
- Browse and filter Logs, pause on older entries, and return to live updates with `End`.

## Reading And Remote

- Read all configuration sections in one operation with `Shift+R` or `Ctrl+R`. Full reads preserve unsaved edits and reject conflicting operations.
- Faster programming reads and targeted channel lookups, with conservative fallback when needed.
- Improved Remote display rendering and keypad handling. Mouse-held PTT releases when you let go, leave the button or view, resize, or lose focus; a safety timeout also limits holds.
- Open Activity directly with `a` and see whether scan heartbeats are arriving or have stopped.

## Hardware-Free Testing

- Connect NicTUI to the separately installed NicFWSim add-on to try the screen, buttons, configuration reads, and synthetic Activity capture without a physical radio.
- Simulator mode accepts only local simulator targets and blocks physical-radio writes and firmware flashing. The simulator is not bundled with NicTUI.

## Experimental ASL Status

- New receive-only ASL COS monitoring and offline replay commands. This reports squelch status, not voice audio, and does not provide an AllStarLink voice bridge.

Remote screen completeness and control availability still depend on the radio firmware. PTT on a real radio can transmit; simulator PTT cannot emit RF.
